setup: CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,n NUMERIC,r REAL,s TEXT COLLATE NOCASE)

cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total BETWEEN 5 AND 10
SELECT count(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 10
SELECT id,n BETWEEN 5 AND 10,n NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 10 FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT NULL BETWEEN 1 AND 2,1 BETWEEN NULL AND 2,1 BETWEEN 0 AND NULL,NULL NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2
SELECT 5 BETWEEN 5 AND 5,5 BETWEEN 6 AND 4,5 NOT BETWEEN 6 AND 4
SELECT 5 BETWEEN 4.5 AND 5.5,typeof(5 BETWEEN 4.5 AND 5.5),'5' BETWEEN 4 AND 6,5 BETWEEN '4' AND '6'
SELECT id,n BETWEEN '5' AND '10',r BETWEEN '5' AND '10' FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT 'bbb' BETWEEN 'AAA' AND 'CCC' COLLATE nocase,('bbb' BETWEEN 'AAA' AND 'CCC') COLLATE nocase,s BETWEEN 'aaa' AND 'ccc' FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT ?1 BETWEEN ?2 AND ?3,?1 NOT BETWEEN ?2 AND ?3
SELECT id,r,typeof(r) FROM t WHERE n BETWEEN ?1 AND ?2 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM t WHERE n BETWEEN 5 AND NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM t WHERE id=1 OR n BETWEEN 9 AND 10 ORDER BY id
SELECT abs(-9223372036854775808) BETWEEN 0 AND 1
SELECT 0 BETWEEN 1 AND abs(-9223372036854775808)
SELECT 1 BETWEEN 1 AND abs(-9223372036854775808)
SELECT e1 . FirstName || ' manages ' || e2 . FirstName FROM Employee e1 JOIN Employee e2 ON e2.ReportsTo=e1.EmployeeId ORDER BY e2.EmployeeId
SELECT e1.FirstName||' manages '||e2.FirstName FROM Employee e1 JOIN Employee e2 ON e2.ReportsTo=e1.EmployeeId ORDER BY e2.EmployeeId
SELECT e1.FirstName||' manages '||e2.FirstName AS manager_line FROM Employee e1 JOIN Employee e2 ON e2.ReportsTo=e1.EmployeeId ORDER BY e2.EmployeeId
SELECT first /* left */ || '-' || last,first||'-'||last FROM names ORDER BY rowid
SELECT '雪:' || first || '!' FROM names ORDER BY rowid
SELECT first||last,first||last,first||last AS named FROM names ORDER BY rowid
SELECT names.first, names . last FROM names ORDER BY rowid
